# Kabbalah Academy India

> Free online introductory course in authentic Kabbalah for India — live classes in Hindi and English, taught by Indian students of Rav Dr. Michael Laitman (Bnei Baruch, Israel). Completely free, no paid tier, ever.

## What we offer

- A free live online introductory Kabbalah course (on Zoom), in Hindi and English — new cohorts start regularly
- Signing up takes only a name, WhatsApp number, and email at https://kabbalahindia.com/#signup
- Authentic lineage: The Ari (1534–1572) → Baal HaSulam (1885–1954) → RABASH (1907–1991) → Rav Dr. Michael Laitman (1946–) → today's Indian teachers
- After the course: ongoing weekly live lessons, volunteering and translation work, local and world conventions

## Key facts

- Completely free — funded by donations from past students; no payment, no login, no premium tier
- Kabbalah is studied as a method of connection, not a religion — Hindus, Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, and atheists study together; no conversion involved
- About 3–4 hours per week: one live morning lesson (60 min, recorded), reading, and a small group call
- In direct association with Bnei Baruch Kabbalah Education & Research Institute, Israel (founded 1991, free education for 150,000+ students worldwide)
